rationale: The plan correctly frames this as a per-sample scoring question, runs GSVA (Gaussian kernel) on a blind VST matrix derived from DESeq2 median-of-ratios size factors, tests the 50x12 score matrix with limma under ~condition (control reference, inflamed minus control) with BH, and draws a condition-annotated hallmark heatmap, matching the reference design. QC is thorough and design-specific: PCA, distance heatmap, library size and detected genes, with an explicit keep-and-inspect policy for sample_01 plus a sensitivity rerun if it sits apart. The filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is tied to the smallest group, and the hallmark collection is named with version (MSigDB 2026.1), human symbols, coverage reporting, and a 10-member floor. The main gap is that no significance alpha is stated for the BH-adjusted score test, so 'sets that pass the test' is left undefined; the report otherwise covers methods, versions, seeds, and design caveats well.
